title: Allegro's theory that the Eucharist was an Amanita muscaria

tellings.quote: he came to the very heretical conclusion that the Eucharist itself was an Amanita muscaria mushroom.

plain: A scholar named John Marco Allegro concluded that the Eucharist, the Christian rite of sacred bread and wine, was at heart the Amanita muscaria, a red-and-white mushroom that causes visions. Michels tells this himself, drawing on Allegro's book The Sacred Mushroom and the Cross, published in 1970, and calls the idea deeply heretical.
